entities.summary: Ray Fujita , is a Japanese actor and musician from Tokyo. His mother is Japanese and his father is French. His most notable roles to date are as Kitazaki/Dragon Orphnoch in the 2003 series Kamen Rider 555 and Rei Suzumura/ZERO the Silver Fanged Knight in the 2006 series GARO. He is also the lead vocalist of the band Dustz. Rei Fujita was a composers & musicians from Nakano (b. 1988-09-06, Nakano). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
